messages:
sam: Heads-up: planned NAT flip for egress in us-east1 on 2026-03-28 03:00 UTC. We'll soft-drain a small cohort of GPU nodes to shift sessions prior to the iptables change. Window ~30m.

marta: Which pools are in scope? Any expected impact to Dedicated pools or SLA exposure?

kyle: Scope: pool `gpu-us-east1-regular` cohort-B subset (~220 GPUs). Dedicated pools are excluded unless we need backfill. Plan: staged cordon -> evict -> nat flip -> warmbackfill + kv-seed -> uncordon.

nora: Ops steps: cordon 10 hosts at a time, drain tasks, flip edge NAT, allow 15m warmbackfill from saturn-pool, run targeted kv-seed for top routes, then uncordon. Keep cohorts small to limit cold-cache storm.

ben: Need customer comms + status page update? finance cost estimate?

sam: I'll open a status incident and update the status page. SLA risk low but app p95 latency might spike briefly during eviction. Cost: estimate burst backfill ~3k tokens/min peak, ~USD 120 total.

kyle: KV cache note: evicted nodes will lose local KV entries; recommend running targeted kv-seed post-flip to reduce quality regressions.

nora: kv-seed example:
```
kubectl run kv-seeder --image=internal/kv-seeder:prod --restart=OnFailure -- /seed \
  --prefix=top100 \
  --rate=200/s
```
Gate it to avoid overloading edge.

deploy-bot: Roll scheduled: roll/1766001234. Steps: cordon -> evict -> nat-flip -> kv-seed -> uncordon. Manual approval required before nat-flip.

marta: Reminder: egress IP rotation can break third-party allowlists. We'll email partners and share old->new mapping. If a partner fails we'll pause for 15m to troubleshoot.

ben: Who's on-call for the window?

kyle: On-call: @kyle and @nora 02:30-04:00 UTC. Finance: cost estimate posted, no blockers.

sre-bot: Monitoring hooks set: latency.p95.gpu_us_east1, errors.rate.gpu_us_east1. Alerts: p95>300ms or errors>0.5% -> page #eng-oncall.

kyle: Tweak: reduce batching during flip to lower queue buildup. Propose batch.max_tokens 128 -> 96 for ~45m around window.

nora: I'll canary the batch config in cohort-A 15m before flip to validate.

sam: Post-flip smoke tests: `curl -s https://api.redwood/test?route=chat` x50 across regions + simple L2 accuracy check.

marta: I'll draft customer comms with timeframe, expected impact, rollback criteria and share in 30m. :thumbsup:

ben: Finance: confirm final cost in post-mortem.

kyle: Runbook + cost breakdown uploaded: https://internal/ops-costs/1766001234

sam: Preflight call 01:45 UTC in #eng-infra for go/no-go. Please ack.

marta: ack

kyle: ack

nora: ack
